title: NYC Changing Station Explorer
description: Finding a changing table shouldn't be a guessing game. NYC Open Data restroom records are mapped by borough and reported placement.

media.label: Map preview
media.alt: NYC borough map of changing tables reported in public restrooms

title: Waterfront Walks
description: What does a waterfront walk feel like underfoot? OpenStreetMap paths in Jersey City and Brooklyn are classified by recorded surface and walking-permission tags.

media.label: Waterfront paths
media.alt: Jersey City and Brooklyn waterfront paths classified by recorded surface

title: Inside the Park
description: Three Jersey City parks become small atlases of play, sport, and movement. OpenStreetMap activity polygons and paths are drawn in separate panels with metric scales.

media.label: Three-park map
media.alt: Activity polygons and paths in Hamilton, Lafayette, and Berry Lane parks

title: Clusters of Play
description: How close are licensed childcare centers to mapped playgrounds? NJ licensing records and OpenStreetMap places are grouped and linked within a 400 m straight-line threshold.

media.label: Citywide map
media.alt: Playgrounds and nearby licensed childcare centers in Jersey City and Hoboken

title: Seeing New York from the Water
description: Lower Manhattan unfolds like a handscroll seen from the water. NYC building footprints and roof heights become layered silhouettes, with art-directed parallax in the animation.

media.label: Skyline and viewing locator
media.alt: Layered Lower Manhattan skyline and its geographic viewing locator

title: A Changing Harbor Edge
description: A harbor chart cataloged as possibly dating to 1844 meets modern mapped shorelines. The NYPL scan is aligned to NYC DCP and OpenStreetMap land outlines with a six-parameter affine transform.

media.label: Historical shoreline overlay
media.alt: Historical New York Harbor chart overlaid with modern mapped shorelines

title: A City at Stroller Speed
description: An Open Streets walk with a stroller became an imagined everyday neighborhood around Rittenhouse Square. Real OpenStreetMap street and park geometry anchors illustrated scenes of care, play, and slower movement.

media.label: Illustrated neighborhood map
media.alt: Illustrated stroller-paced neighborhood around the real Rittenhouse Square boundary

title: A Landscape of Surnames
description: Taiwan's twenty most common surnames form a schematic landscape. MOI household-registration counts scale the glyphs, while real NOAA ETOPO depth bands frame the island.

media.label: Surname landscape with final bathymetry
media.alt: Population-scaled Taiwanese surname glyphs over a schematic island and genuine depth bands

title: Heritage Across East Asia
description: How old are East Asia's UNESCO cultural heritage sites? Official site records and reviewed historical phases drive a component-level map and timeline, keeping formation dates separate from inscription years.

media.label: Historical heritage map
media.alt: East Asian UNESCO cultural heritage locations colored by historical formation phases

title: Where Sounds Ripple
description: One character, many readings: “水” becomes a field of water patterns. Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang records supply initials and finals, encoded by color and categorical wave textures over Natural Earth and NOAA ETOPO geography.

media.label: Pronunciation map
media.alt: Recorded pronunciations of water across Cantonese-speaking communities, encoded as wave patterns

title: The Shape of Wind
description: Two ERA5 snapshots catch winter and late-summer wind over East Asia and the western Pacific. RK4 streamlines and animated brightness follow each date's fixed 10 m vector field, with Natural Earth land as context.

media.label: January snapshot
media.alt: ERA5 10 m wind streamlines over the western Pacific on 15 January 2025 at 06:00 UTC

media.label: September snapshot
media.alt: ERA5 10 m wind streamlines over the western Pacific on 5 September 2025 at 06:00 UTC

title: Where Night Comes From
description: Late-evening home-area associations connect the 40th Street area to origins across Philadelphia and beyond. Advan Neighborhood Patterns+ records are mapped by Census Block Group for August and September 2025; scaled associations are not unique visitors.

publication.reason: Dewey / Advan data-use clearance is pending.

media.label: Late-evening home-area associations
media.alt: Blue-cyan Census Block Group home-area associations for a selected destination near 40th and Walnut Streets
